# UsageAttribution.com

Independent reference project on usage attribution, provenance, and transparent reuse of digital information.

## Canonical Resource

- [Home](https://usageattribution.com/)

## Main Sections

- [Sources](https://usageattribution.com/sources/)

## Purpose

UsageAttribution.com provides an independent reference on usage attribution, provenance, citation structures, and transparent attribution across digital information systems.
